programs.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programs.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places.

programs.title: Insane Pools: Off the Deep End
programs.desc: Lucas Congdon, founder of Lucas Lagoons, is a swimming pool designer.He treats his work in an artistic way, and its effects are unique.The resulting pools are real works of art.
